name: kem-3d

creator.name: Nam Học AI
creator.niche: Kỹ năng AI (edit video, làm nội dung, làm việc hiệu quả) cho người Việt mới bắt đầu, chỉ từng bước bằng tiếng Việt

notes: Faceless motion design, paper only all along (seam 1920): no camera. The whole picture is ONE HTML frame component (assets/components/scene.html: gradient background, dot grid, floating stickers, kicker + hook title, 3D tilted window cards, the mascot), captured --alpha off for the whole short and wired as an overlay from 0. Engine captions on top.

Background: cream #F4EEE4, a big soft peach glow top left, a faint yellow glow right, a cool pale blue glow bottom right, a faint grey dot grid (54 px pitch), 6 to 8 small stickers drifting slowly: orange stars and pink stars with a white outline, blue and purple dots, small clouds with a dashed colored outline.

Hook (0 to ~4 s): kicker in accent spaced caps with a dot at y 185 (about 32 px, letter-spacing .14em), then a heavy tight sans title (Inter 800, ~92 px, tracking -.05em) building word by word on the words said, centered at y 290 to 410, ONE word in italic serif accent (Noto Serif Display Italic, Instrument Serif has no Vietnamese). Under it a 3D tilted video window (browser chrome with 3 dots and a red play icon, progress bar, mono timecode, an accent timecode chip) that flies in from depth and changes content on the words.

Cards: white or dark windows ~900 px wide, rounded 26 px, a soft deep shadow, tilted in 3D (rotateX 8 to 14 deg, rotateY -10 to 10 deg, perspective 1400). They fly in from depth with a blur (scale .7 -> 1, blur 14 px -> 0, .45 s), stack on each other (the next card lands in front, offset), and leave by flying up / blurring out. One card or one stack per idea, something changes every 1 to 2 s (a counter ticks, text types, a chip lands, a check appears).

Small UI chips on the cards: white rounded pills with an icon and a big ink number counting up ('60,000 views'), a dark label chip with a calendar icon ('In 2 days'), a round white badge with the real logo, a prompt bar with an accent send button that types, a file chip with a green check.

Mascot: the channel's ORIGINAL coral spark buddy (assets/components/buddy.js), small (60 to 80 px), perched on a card corner, hopping to the next card and reacting (wow, cheer). Never the original's pixel crab.
Pace: tight, the original's pauses are .2 to .37 s; no hard cut anywhere (motion carries the rhythm).
Real logos for every tool named (assets/logos). No emoji on screen, no em-dash.
Format: 9:16 vertical, faceless (no camera ever). The length follows the voiceover: every silence cut, nothing added after the last word.

Audio: ONLY the creator's voice + a small music bed (spec music.bed, 'code-noir' for Claude Code / building topics, 'arpege' for AI news, 'enquete' when unsure; mix.music -32, ducked under the voice). Any clip from takes/ used as visual is MUTED (its own sound, the 'pilot' audio, never plays). Sound effects: only a soft 'bell' (sfx.extra, -14) on 2 or 3 payoffs, nothing on entrances.

Captions (engine dim + curPill): Vietnamese, 1 to 3 words per phrase, heavy black Inter 800 ~74 px at y 1330, the phrase builds word by word, the word being spoken sits on the orange block (#DC6331, small radius) in white. captions.hide over the hook while the title says the same words.
Delivery: always write output/short-<slug>.srt (short times, 1 to 3 words per cue, same chunks as the on-screen captions) next to the mp4.
